meta.name: user-story-mapping
meta.description: Create a user story map that lays out activities, steps, tasks, and release slices. Use when planning a workflow, backlog, or MVP around the user journey.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将用户旅程拆解为可交付的功能切片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用用户故事地图规划产品路线图或迭代。
copy.tagline_en: Break down user journeys into deliverable slices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a product roadmap or iteration using user story mapping.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你一步步创建用户故事地图，包括定义用户、活动、步骤、任务，并按优先级划分发布切片。
howto.when: 当你需要规划用户旅程、梳理待办事项或确定 MVP 范围时，可以要求 Claude 创建故事地图。

say.text: 帮我为报销流程创建一个故事地图，从提交到打款。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义用户、活动、步骤和任务。

say.text: 为我们的新功能规划用户故事地图，识别 MVP 范围。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成地图并标记优先级。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you step by step to create a user story map, including defining the user, activities, steps, tasks, and prioritizing them into release slices.
howto.when_en: When you need to plan a user journey, organize a backlog, or define an MVP scope, you can ask Claude to create a story map.

say_en.text: Create a story map for our expense reporting flow, from submission to reimbursement.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining users, activities, steps, and tasks.

say_en.text: Map the user journey for our new feature and identify the MVP scope.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the map with priority slices.
